machine.amd64_emulation: verified — docker run --platform linux/amd64 alpine uname -m -> x86_64

docker.data_folder: /Volumes/Elements/Docker/DockerDesktop (external APFS SSD; Docker requires the SSD attached to start)

dataset.name: terminal-bench
dataset.note: all 89 tasks resolve to the same repo and commit; this commit is the dataset revision pin. Images are prebuilt linux/amd64 (alexgshaw/<task>:20251031 on Docker Hub) and are pulled, not built — every task runs under Rosetta emulation; native arm64 does not exist for this dataset.

trajectory_format.pin: ATIF (Agent Trajectory Interchange Format), schema_version <= ATIF-v1.7 as emitted by harbor 0.22.0 terminus-2 (SUPPORTS_ATIF)
trajectory_format.step_shape: step_id (1-based), source (system|user|agent), message, reasoning_content, tool_calls[{tool_call_id, function_name, arguments}], observation{results[{source_call_id, content}]}, per-step metrics (token counts), llm_call_count

per_trial_artifacts: agent/ (trajectory + agent logs; oracle.txt for oracle trials)
tamper_surface: tests/ and solution/ are uploaded to the environment only at verifier time (harbor verifier._resolve_tests + upload_dir); during the agent phase the checker is absent — the agent cannot read or modify it. Container network is available by default (allow_internet unset in all 89 task.toml files).

live_trial.config: hy3-terminus-2 (agent terminus-2 2.0.0, model openai/hy3, parser json)
live_trial.credentials: OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL loaded by harbor --env-file from an owner-created file outside the repo; values never printed or stored
live_trial.outcome: resolved, official reward 1.0, both verifier checks passed

token_cost.note: an easy 15-step clean solve — the cheap end of the expected 100K-1M per-run range; the ~300K/run planning average and the campaign projection (~16-18M central, <=35M worst) stand

live_trial.bundle: imported and hash-verified (content-addressed id f407372282d481d9…, RunBundle schema v1)
